t: You're at the Royal United Services Institute, in Whitehall. It's the world's oldest defence and security think tank, founded in 1831 by the first Duke of Wellington. Arthur Wellesley was a Field Marshal and a leading figure in early nineteenth-century British politics, serving as Prime Minister and as Commander-in-Chief of the Forces. The link continues today, since the institute's current chair is the ninth Duke of Wellington, and its director-general is Rachel Ellehuus.
